title: Booking-Lead Share of the Bluegate Moving Truck Rental Authorization Hold
content:
**Booking lead table.** The Bluegate Moving Truck Rental hold booking-lead share depends on the calendar days from the reservation date to the scheduled pickup date: fewer than **2** days take **1.25** of the card deposit, **14** or more days take **0.9**, and any other lead keeps the card deposit as it is.

| Calendar days from reservation date to scheduled pickup date | Share of the card deposit |
|---|---|
| 0 (reserved on the pickup date) | 1.25 |
| 1 | 1.25 |
| 2 | As it is |
| 13 | As it is |
| 14 | 0.9 |
| 30 | 0.9 |

Boundary cases (hypothetical scheduled pickup on 15 May): reserved 14 May, 1.25; reserved 13 May, as it is; reserved 2 May, as it is; reserved 1 May, 0.9.
